content.short: Founders Fund is a global venture capital firm investing in Web3 companies.
content.description: Founded in 2005, Founders Fund launched to invest in smart people solving difficult problems. It is led by technology innovators Peter Thiel, Brian Singerman, and Joey Krug. The firm has invested in a range of digital assets and Web3 projects, including Bitcoin, Paxos, Bullish, and Block Green, a lending protocol for Bitcoin miners lacking access to capital. Founders Fund earned $1.8B from Bitcoin investments that were sold during the 2021 bull market.
